analysis: Paired full-minus-none block differences, per-city 20-block bootstrap 95% intervals, seed 8141, 10000 resamples. Report CO2 jointly with completion; retain all exclusions, unfinished trips, safety and teleports. No radio or inference. Cases already used in development; not confirmatory.
reuse: Reuse the 12 completed preexisting_closure_v1 full-uptake blocks after input/output hashes; do not rerun duplicates.
purpose: Quantify whether incident routing has reproducible application consequences and whether unresolved simulator failures vary by intervention. This bounds traffic claims; it cannot demonstrate content-auditor benefit.
